title: Professional Looking
text: Professional Looking. My son just graduated from college. His diploma arrived a few days ago. I ordered this frame for it. It's a very nice frame and professional looking. It's a good quality. It has a stand and a hook. His diploma took the whole space so we didn't need the mats, but the mats did look nice.

product_metadata.title: ASmileIndeep 8.5x11 Diploma Frame with Mat or Display 11x14 Certificate, Document, Picture Frame without Mat, Mahogany Solid Wood & HD Plexiglass Degree Frame, Perfect for Graduation Gift
features: 🎁【PERFECT DESIGN】This diploma frame is suitable for 8.5x11 with double mat, or 11x14 without mat, perfect for displaying your certificates, degrees, pictures and documents. This elegant and stylish solid mahogany wood diploma frame design will turn any bare wall into your art gallery and highlight the honor of your display. Don't let your diploma collect dust in a drawer, display it proudly for all to see!

🎁【PREMIUM QUALITY】The 8.5 x 11 picture frame is made of high quality solid wood greatly improves durability and has a classy look. The panel is made of high-definition thickened plexiglass (not glass), which is not only clearer and scratch-proof, but also safe and not easy to be broken.

🎁【TWO DISPLAY CHOICES】The diploma certificate frame comes with upgraded two-way hanging hardware that supports horizontal or vertical accessibility for wall-mounted displays, while the easel stand can be used for desktop or tabletop displays.

🎁【EASY TO USE】Multiple easy-to-open and close pull tabs on the back of the frame make it easy to secure your college diploma, ensuring it won't slip and move. The included mounting hardware comes pre-installed for easy use.

🎁【SAFE PACKAGING】ASmileIndeep has developed exclusive high protection packaging that helps ensure the safe delivery of fragile items. Order with confidence and join the ranks of proud diploma holders! Whether it's a prestigious award, high school diploma, college degree, master's degree or more, showcase a valuable accomplishment with this perfect certificate frame that makes a great graduation/induction/birthday gift!
